name: ISO 22301:2019
description: Business Continuity Management Systems — Requirements. Specifies requirements to plan, establish, implement, operate, monitor, review, maintain, and continually improve a documented management system to protect against, reduce the likelihood of, and ensure recovery from disruptions.

controls.title: Understanding the organization and its context
controls.description: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcomes of its BCMS.

controls.title: Leadership and commitment
controls.description: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to the business continuity management system.

controls.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
controls.description: When planning for the BCMS, the organization shall consider the issues referred to in 4.1 and determine the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed.

controls.title: Business impact analysis and risk assessment
controls.description: The organization shall establish, implement, and maintain a formal and documented process for business impact analysis and risk assessment.

controls.title: Business continuity strategy
controls.description: The organization shall determine an appropriate business continuity strategy to protect prioritized activities and their dependencies, based on outputs from the BIA and risk assessment.

controls.title: Business continuity plans and procedures
controls.description: The organization shall document procedures to recover its activities, continue operation of prioritized activities at a pre-defined level, restore business operations to normal conditions.

controls.title: Exercise programme
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that its BCPs are exercised and tested at planned intervals to ensure that they are consistent with BC objectives.

controls.title: Evaluation and revision of business continuity procedures
controls.description: The organization shall evaluate business continuity documentation during and after exercises, actual disruptions, and at planned intervals.

controls.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
controls.description: The organization shall evaluate the business continuity management system performance and the effectiveness of the BCMS.

controls.title: Internal audit
controls.description: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the BCMS conforms to requirements.

controls.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
controls.description: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall react to the nonconformity, evaluate the need for action, and implement corrective actions.
